svg.aria-label: Decision flowchart: on wake, check failed work from last time (transient errors requeue via heal, corrupt source files re-download via refetch, three-strike items park for a human); then check for new EOs (scout downloads and enqueues them); then loop while there is queued work and time/budget remain (claim takes the oldest item); for each item, extract with a native-PDF to rendered-image fallback ladder, run a deterministic audit gate plus a Gemini critic with human-review fallback, resolve ambiguous vehicle matches, mark superseded predecessors, write matches, and loop back to claim the next item; when the queue empties or the run runs out of time or budget, write the run summary and sleep until tomorrow.
svg.title: CarbLegal decision flowchart
